controles.affirmation: Forward sale agreements: 42,5 M d'actions au S1 2026 (produit min. 3,2 Mds $); 69,7 M d'actions non reglees au 30/06/2026 (produit min. 5,2 Mds $)
controles.verbatim_source: During the six months ended June 30, 2026, Xcel Energy Inc. entered forward sale agreements for shares of common stock totaling 42.5 million shares (minimum expected proceeds of $3.2 billion). ... As of June 30, 2026, 69.7 million shares remain unsettled on forward equity agreements and collared forward equity agreements (minimum expected proceeds of $5.2 billion). (10-Q T2 2026)

controles.verbatim_source: Weighted average common shares outstanding: Diluted | 627 | 588 (10-Q T2 2026, compte de resultat)

controles.affirmation: Billets de tresorerie et emprunts a terme passes de 1 550 M$ fin 2025 a 2 510 M$ fin juin 2026

controles.affirmation: En mai 2026 le MPUC a confirme une sanction de 41 M$ apres avoir juge NSP-Minnesota imprudente sur l'arret de Prairie Island; 37 M$ de remboursement supplementaire comptabilises au T1 2026
controles.verbatim_source: In a September 2024 decision, the MPUC ruled NSP-Minnesota was imprudent in the operation of the Prairie Island nuclear plant... In March 2026, the ALJ recommended a $41 million disallowance of estimated replacement power costs. In May 2026, the MPUC ordered a $41 million disallowance, consistent with the ALJ recommendation. NSP-Minnesota recognized an incremental $37 million in customer refunds, including interest, to electric revenues in the first quarter of 2026.

controles.affirmation: Incendie de Marshall: 640 M$ de paiements, aucune faute admise, 298 M$ de charges en 2025, credit net de 19 M$ au S1 2026, tous les plaignants regles en juillet 2026
controles.verbatim_source: In September 2025, Xcel Energy and other defendants reached settlement agreements in principle that resolved all claims and required PSCo to make settlement payments of $640 million. PSCo did not admit any fault, wrongdoing or negligence... As of July 2026, settlements have been executed with all plaintiffs and subrogation insurers. ... PSCo recognized charges to earnings of $298 million in the year ended Dec. 31, 2025... contributing to a net $19 million credit to earnings for the six months ended June 30, 2026.

controles.affirmation: Tarifs data centers: decision PSCW attendue debut 2027, tarif Colorado toujours en instruction, seul le Minnesota approuve en juin 2026
controles.verbatim_source: NSP-Minnesota -- The tariff, which was approved by the MPUC in June 2026... NSP-Wisconsin filed a proposed tariff in the second quarter of 2026... A PSCW decision is expected in early 2027. PSCo -- The proposed tariff, filed in the second quarter of 2026... A CPUC decision is expected in late 2026 or early 2027.

controles.verbatim_source: Net cash used in investing activities | (5,959) | (4,430) ; Net cash provided by operating activities | 2,797 | 2,109

controles.affirmation: Resultat net T2 2026 586 M$ (BPA dilue 0,93 $) contre 444 M$ (0,75 $); revenus electriques 2 740 M$ contre 2 878 M$ (-4,8%)
Base tarifaire PSCo 23,8 Mds $ (+23,3% sur un an); ROE GAAP 5,66% et ROE ongoing 7,55%
controles.verbatim_source: PSCo ... Rate Base (estimated) | $23.8 billion | GAAP ROE | 5.66% | Ongoing ROE (See Item 7) | 7.55% (10-K FY2025)

controles.affirmation: HOOK: 'au Colorado son autorite regulatrice ne lui accorde qu'un rendement de 5,66% contre 7,55% vise'
controles.verbatim_source: Terms of the settlement include: ... ROE of 9.3% and equity ratio of 54.5% (2025 Colorado Electric Rate Case, 10-Q T2 2026) ; 2025 Colorado Natural Gas Rate Case: ROE of 9.2%
controles.correction_proposee: Le regulateur du Colorado n'accorde pas 5,66% : le ROE autorise/negocie est de 9,3% (electricite) et 9,2% (gaz). 5,66% est le ROE GAAP effectivement realise par PSCo en 2025 et 7,55% son ROE 'ongoing', ni l'un ni l'autre n'etant un taux accorde par le regulateur. Reformuler : 'PSCo n'a degage qu'un ROE GAAP de 5,66% en 2025, contre un ROE autorise de 9,3% au Colorado'.

controles.affirmation: 'Sous-remuneration reglementaire persistante au Colorado' : l'ecart entre ROE GAAP 5,66% et ongoing 7,55% 'signale que la regulation locale n'a pas encore rattrape le rythme des investissements engages'
controles.verbatim_source: GAAP diluted EPS -- 2025 | $3.42 | Marshall Wildfire settlement | 0.38 | Ongoing diluted EPS -- 2025 | $3.80 (10-K FY2025, reconciliation GAAP/ongoing) ; PSCo recognized charges to earnings of $298 million in the year ended Dec. 31, 2025
controles.correction_proposee: L'ecart entre ROE GAAP 5,66% et ROE ongoing 7,55% chez PSCo ne traduit pas un retard reglementaire : il correspond a la charge non recurrente de reglement de l'incendie de Marshall (298 M$ en 2025), seul element du pont GAAP/ongoing publie par le groupe. Supprimer l'interpretation reglementaire ou la remplacer par la cause reelle.
